csharp_space_around_binary_operators #

Spacing around binary operators. Observed and not implemented: at none the oracle closes up assignment, additive, multiplicative, relational, shift, bitwise and logical operators at once — var t=q+r;, var v=q<r ? 1 : 0;, var z=p&&q>0;. ignore is indistinguishable from before_and_after on every input tried, so only one of the three values is observable. ⚠ Blocked on the one mechanism the registry does not have: expands propagates a generalized key's value TEXT into the keys it names, so it can only reach targets whose domain — and whose polarity — is its own. Three keys need the same missing piece and none of them is a coverage gap: this one, csharp_space_between_parentheses and csharp_new_line_before_members_in_object_initializers. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified implementable — blocked on a polarity-aware expands. The recorded reason is verified rather than inherited: at none the oracle closes up assignment, additive, relational, bitwise and logical operators at once (var t=q+r;, var z=p>0&&q>0;) while ignore is indistinguishable from before_and_after; Skala is flat at all three. Two distinct oracle outputs against one of Skala's, so an oracle glob would report INERT and none is added while the expands mechanism cannot carry a generalized key's value across a differing domain and polarity.

Typeone of before_and_after, none, ignore

dotnet_style_parentheses_in_arithmetic_binary_operators #

Parentheses around an arithmetic operand of an arithmetic operator. ⚠ Governs the pair: the parenthesised expression and its parent must both be arithmetic, so (a + b) > c has no key and goes at either value. Shift and the bitwise family are resharper_parentheses_non_obvious_operations instead.

resharper_wrap_after_binary_opsign #

Whether a break in a binary chain lands after the operator rather than before it. ⚠ Probed rather than reasoned about: eleven fixtures under this repository's own .editorconfig, one cleanupcode invocation per configuration, each fixture first shown to move under the key that really governs its construct. Inert at both values, at 120 and at 60 columns, and with csharp_wrap_before_binary_opsign = false in the same run so the operator's own side could not be deciding first — that key moves the operator across the break on its own and is Tier A.
